title: SLO-threshold-driven passive promotion criteria and restore smoke tests
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Define a deterministic decision-tree and executable checklist for promoting a passive region to active in response to SLO breaches or regional failures, coupled with a compact suite of backup/restore smoke tests to validate KV state, tokenstore integrity, and routing configuration before accepting production traffic. This ticket produces: 1) a clear set of SLO triggers (error budget burn, latency, and availability) mapped to promotion tiers; 2) automated gating checks (health probes, KV diff hashes, sample reads/writes) that must pass for traffic cutover; 3) circuit-breaker and load-shedding parameter recommendations for inverse-scaling scenarios; 4) a short drill script for scheduled rehearsals and a post-mortem checklist template. Key SLO/trigger definitions we will standardize here: - Availability SLO: 99.95% per region (weekly window). - Error-rate trigger: sustained 0.5% 5xx rate over rolling 10m or 2x error budget burn in 1 hour. - Latency trigger: p99 user-facing generation latency > 600ms for 10m while throughput is within 80% of normal. - KV-consistency gate: snapshot hash equality for primary vs passive within allowed drift window (last successful snapshot age < 30m). Promotion tiers and decision tree (brief): - Tier 0 (Soft degrade): local rate limit + circuit breaker at 95% flows; do not promote. - Tier 1 (Partial outage): error-rate trigger met + region health checks failing -> enable emergency routing to passive for low-priority routes only (10-30%). - Tier 2 (Major outage / sustained SLO breach): promotion preconditions run; if all gates pass, promote passive region to active with staged traffic ramp and load-shedding preserved for low-priority backends. Gates before promotion (all must be YES unless explicitly overridden with justification): - Control-plane connectivity: API control-plane reachability verified from passive region endpoints. - KV snapshot validation: run fast-compare tool to compute rolling snapshot hash for last 3 snapshots; mismatch > 0.01% requires manual reconciliation. - Tokenstore smoke: read-write token lifecycle test (create temporary token, long-lived session handshake, revoke and assert deny). - Model artifacts: verified model checksums and quantization profile match expected release tag. - Routing sanity: canary DNS + health-checks confirm passive ingress accepts 100 requests/s per replica without immediate failures. Restore smoke tests (to run after any restore operation): 1) KV keyset spot-check: sample 500 keys across hot/shard buckets, assert read latency < 30ms and checksums match prior snapshot manifest. 2) Write-forward validation: write a sequence of 1k small requests, read back with idempotency tokens and verify no duplication/lost writes. 3) Telemetry sanity: ingest synthetic trace and confirm end-to-end span appears in tracing pipeline within 60s. 4) Observability gates: dashboards (errors, p99, kv-miss-rate, cache-hit-rate) return to within 10% of baseline. Circuit-breaker & load-shedding guidance: - Primary breaker: open if 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m or p95 CPU > 88% across >50% of replicas. - Graceful shedding: drop non-critical feature flags and background requests first (embeddings, long-context rerankers) using priority buckets. - Fallback policy: auto-route to smaller, cheaper model variant only if latency-sensitive SLOs are at risk and model-compatibility test passes. Implementation deliverables: - Decision-tree YAML config stored in infra repo for automation. - A short runbook markdown for on-call with commands, monitoring queries (PromQL) and run-step checklist. - A smoke-test harness (Go binary) and a GH actions workflow to run against restored environments. Acceptance criteria: - Decision tree YAML + runbook merged and reviewed by SRE and Platform Eng. - Smoke tests pass on a staged restore of a snapshot (test cluster). - Drill executed end-to-end once during cycle, with retro and incident timeline. Communication plan: - Notify customers via status page if performing an actual promotion. For drills, announce in #platform-drills and provide opt-out windows for high-impact customers. Links and artifacts: - Draft runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/RUNBOOK-DR-templates - Draft decision tree PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1824 - Smoke test harness (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/dr-scripts (branch: slo-gates) Owners: Marco Li (lead on automation), Aisha Kapoor (validation suite), Ops on-call (promotion execution).
